It recovers from political standing and command stability. AUTHORITY 100 REVIEW BLOCKERS HVO DECISION REQUIRED Herzeg-Bosna · 5 Jul 1993 Mostar Records the Scope of Croat Territorial Claims PRESIDENTIAL RESPONSE Pragmatic maximum: cantons-plus Banovina framing HISTORICAL DEFAULT This is the historically attested choice. You are free to choose any option. Hold the cantons-plus posture: HZ HB is one of three constitutive ethnic provinces / republics with central-Bosnia and western Herzegovina territorial allocation along the 1939 Banovina template the Vance-Owen and Owen-Stoltenberg plans ratify. The Tudjman-Šušak scope-restraint channel is honored; the central-Bosnia airbridge sustains Žepče and the Vitez triangle through to the Washington framework; the Geneva / Owen-Stoltenberg / Contact Group / Washington diplomatic circuits remain open; the Federation channel is reachable when sanctions pressure on Croatia tightens at March 1994. Herzeg-Bosna morale +2 Herzeg-Bosna Military Credibility +5 Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence +5 Herzeg-Bosna Negotiating Leverage +5 Herzeg-Bosna Internal Cohesion +3 Minimum consolidation: pull back to Mostar + western Herzegovina Concede the central-Bosnia pockets diplomatically: abandon the Vitez triangle and the Žepče exclave as untenable, consolidate to Mostar plus western Herzegovina (Posušje, Grude, Ljubuški, Čitluk, Široki Brijeg, Tomislavgrad). The airbridge is wound down. The Federation-track with Sarajevo opens early on the back of central-Bosnia abandonment (alliance_change positive with RBiH), but the Croat-nationalist faction inside HZ HB revolts against the pocket-abandonment posture, Tudjman's patron-confidence collapses on the unilateral consolidation that defies the spring-1993 airbridge directive, and the territorial-legitimacy claim narrows to the Mostar+Herzegovina footprint that Dayton ultimately confirms. Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina / Herzeg-Bosna alliance +0.1 Herzeg-Bosna morale -2 Herzeg-Bosna Territorial Legitimacy -2

The tribunal has jurisdiction over genocide, crimes against humanity, and violations of the laws of war committed in the former Yugoslavia since 1991. While indictments are years away, the era of impunity may be ending. INTELLIGENCE ASSESSMENT VRS patron pressure +5 HVO patron pressure +3 The ICTY opens for business in The Hague. Every commander who orders atrocities now does so with knowledge that a court exists to try them. It transforms Sarajevo's siege from a total blockade into a strangled but survivable containment. INTELLIGENCE ASSESSMENT ARBiH supply +10 ARBiH morale +5 Sarajevo breathes again. The tunnel is a military and psychological lifeline — proof that the city's will to resist can find a way through any encirclement.
